coach_time_duty.name: coach_time_duty
coach_time_duty.value: "coach_time_entries"."duty" IN ('head','assistant') AND ("coach_time_entries"."owner_duty" IS NULL OR "coach_time_entries"."owner_duty" IN ('head','assistant')) AND ("coach_time_entries"."approved_duty" IS NULL OR "coach_time_entries"."approved_duty" IN ('head','assistant'))

coach_time_minutes.name: coach_time_minutes
coach_time_minutes.value: ("coach_time_entries"."owner_minutes" IS NULL OR "coach_time_entries"."owner_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1440) AND ("coach_time_entries"."approved_minutes" IS NULL OR "coach_time_entries"."approved_minutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1440) AND ("coach_time_entries"."approved_cents" IS NULL OR "coach_time_entries"."approved_cents" >= 0)
